description: Add one or more existing Loc8IDs (by their short code) to a collection, given the collection's name or ID. Use this after loc8id_create/loc8id_create_many when the user wants the new locations filed into a collection. Adding a Loc8ID you don't own to your collection is a Pro feature.

collection_id_or_name.description: The collection's name (as the user knows it) or its UUID.

name: collection_add_loc8id
